text:
sarah_cs: Heads up — LatticeHealth is ready to start their EU + APAC pilot tomorrow. They need: enable eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 on their account, a temporary QPS bump to 35 for their pilot routes, and an egress IP whitelist for our edge peering so their firewall allows traffic. They want the changes auto-revoked after 72 hours.

mike_net: Copy. Can you paste the exact IP ranges and the routes they'll call? Also need the customer ASN if they're peering.

sarah_cs: Customer provided ranges: 198.51.100.0/24 and 203.0.113.128/25 (they're using test nets through a dev proxy). Routes: POST /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. No ASN (they're not doing BGP peering), just IP allowlist on our edge.

jen_se: For the QPS bump, we'll add a temporary quota override on the account and tag it with `pilot-lattice-1713456789` so it auto-expires. Suggest applying rate window only to the two routes to limit blast radius. Example override payload:

```
{
  "account": "latticehealth",
  "overrides": [
    {"route": "/v1/generate", "qps": 35},
    {"route": "/v1/embeddings", "qps": 12}
  ],
  "expires_in": "72h",
  "tag": "pilot-lattice-1713456789"
}
```

rahul_support: Noted renewal risk — onboarding has been slipping a bit, CS flagged low usage before pilot. I'm updating the CRM renewal note and scheduling an enablement session during pilot week.

mike_net: Ok I can provision the edge allowlist. Two questions: do you want these IPs added globally (all edge regions) or only to eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1? Also confirm whether to create short-lived firewall entries with an auto-delete job.

sarah_cs: Add to only eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1 for now. Please create auto-delete / revoke at exactly 72h. If pilot goes well, we'll request a permanent entry.

mike_net: Will do. Creating ephemeral rules now, tagging them `lattice-pilot-ephemeral`. ETA ~15m.

deploy-bot: scheduled: ephemeral-allowlist-create (id: ea-1713456789) started for eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1.

mike_net: Done — allowlist pushed to edge. Rules: eu-west-1 -> 198.51.100.0/24, ap-southeast-1 -> 203.0.113.128/25. Auto-revoke set to 72h from now. I also added a canary to route `/v1/generate` on eu-west-1 at 10% traffic to monitor latency.

jen_se: I applied the quota override for those routes with `pilot-lattice-1713456789` tag. Embeddings kept lower to avoid token storm. Please verify from the customer side.

tara_lattice: @sarah_cs @jen_se @mike_net thanks — I can confirm the calls are hitting eu-west-1 now. Seeing ~12 QPS steady, good latency. We'll start ramping traffic in the next 2 hours and report any errors. :thumbsup:

rahul_support: Captured action items in CRM: 1) Monitor pilot metrics daily, 2) Schedule enablement session after 24h, 3) Follow up on renewal cadence if adoption low.

sarah_cs: Perfect. If we see issues, we'll fallback to the hosted-lite model and throttle. Otherwise, we ask ops to extend permanent allowlist request if pilot hits SLA targets.

mike_net: FYI I left notes in the ticket with the exact commands I ran and the audit id. If anyone wants the CLI snippets ping me and I'll paste.

tara_lattice: One small ask — can the 72h expiry be extended by support+CS without a full ticket if traffic looks healthy? We may need a 24h extension.

jen_se: We can do a single extension via the admin console up to +48h with approval from CS. Documented in runbook `pilot-ephemeral-allowlist.md`.

sarah_cs: Great. Closing loop — monitor for 48hr then sync. Thanks team.
